_desc: Hero presentation (home page top). Identity fields come from profile.json; socials from socials.json — this file only holds what is specific to how the hero renders.
_sources: roleLine and bio are DERIVED phrasings of resume facts (GitHub bio 'Machine Learning Engineer'; PDEU B.Tech CS 2023-2027; resume summary 'architecting end-to-end AI solutions from data engineering to scalable deployment'). Reword freely — facts only.

_fields.roleLine: 2-3 short descriptors rendered separated by ' · ', followed by the copy-to-clipboard email. Reference: ['Engineer', 'Polymath'].
_fields.avatarTreatment: 'colored-disc' = reference style (blue disc in light mode, yellow in dark) | 'plain' = image as-is | describe anything else.
_fields.spotifyFallbackText: Shown if the Spotify API returns nothing — or used INSTEAD of the API when features.spotify is false but you still want the music strip. "" = strip hidden entirely when Spotify is off.

bio: Building end-to-end AI solutions — from data engineering to scalable deployment.
